editorial:
Imagine a stranger knocking on your door and pulling you into a nightmare you never asked for. That is the setup here. You follow John, a tired family man who has lost his job and his confidence. When a mysterious man named Richie shows up, John gets dragged into a violent road trip that changes him forever. The movie mixes crime, drama, and mystery into one tense ride.

The acting is the real highlight. Samuel L. Jackson brings a scary calm to Richie, while Luke Wilson plays the scared everyman well. The pacing keeps you on edge, though some scenes feel a bit slow. The story has a few twists that keep you guessing. If you like dark thrillers with a psychological edge, this one is worth your time. You can stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray for your collection.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, you learn Richie is not just a random killer. He is connected to John's past and has been pushing John to find his dark side. John finally snaps and fights back to protect his family. Richie is killed, and John returns home changed but alive. The twist reveals the whole ride was meant to break John's weakness and turn him into someone willing to do anything for his loved ones.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves dark psychological thrillers with strong acting.
